subject: The one mistake 90% of new users make
preview_text: It's costing you valuable insights. Open the app now to fix it before the next race.
body_paragraphs: You just downloaded Predictify. Most people open it, stare at the racecards, and get overwhelmed. They close it. They miss everything. Don't be them. Not today.

The secret? Ignore the noise. Don't try to analyze everything at once. The real value isn't in drowning in data—it's in one instant, gut-check answer. Which horse has the AI screaming 'YES' right now? That's the only question you need for your first win.

Open the app. Right now. On the home screen, you'll see today's featured race. Look for the horse with the highest 'Confidence Score'—that glowing percentage. Our AI has already crunched the jockey form, track conditions, and ten thousand other variables. That score is your 30-second cheat code. It's your quick win.

Tap that race. See the top pick. Feel that shift from guessing to knowing. That's the point. Do it now. P.S. The AI spotted a massive weight advantage in the 3:30 at Cheltenham today. It's not even close. But you have to look.
